ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 40:60 ratio of low-intensity (black) to high-intensity (white) pixels on the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity region centered at the peduncle junction, extending into proximal lobe areas. High-intensity fields dominate the distal regions of both lobes, featuring minor low-intensity mottling concentrated near the central dark mass.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude irregular pixel variations (serrations) along the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased amplitude at the distal lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve fitted to the trailing edge from the distal tips toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular brownish-white pixel groups (consistent with barnacle colonization) at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle encrustation visible on the extreme outer edges/tips of both fluke lobes.
